title: 同岗位薪资分布与异常
context: 薪酬分析师需要同部门同岗位的横向基准。
requirements: 2025-12实发基础薪资；同部门同职位至少3人；计算组均值、排名以及偏离均值超过15%的员工；异常仅表示复核候选。
commonError: 比较全部员工薪资忽略岗位、职级和部门。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT employee_id,department_id,position_id,base_cents,AVG(base_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id,position_id) avg_base,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id,position_id) n,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY department_id,position_id ORDER BY base_cents DESC) salary_rank FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key='2025-12') SELECT employee_id,department_id,position_id,base_cents,ROUND(avg_base,2) avg_base_cents,salary_rank,ROUND(100.0*(base_cents-avg_base)/NULLIF(avg_base,0),2) deviation_pct FROM a WHERE n>=3 AND ABS(base_cents-avg_base)>avg_base*.15 ORDER BY department_id,position_id,salary_rank,employee_id
